items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: But I think Frank used to use a pick. Sometimes, huh? Yeah. He was a good guitar player.

ctx.x: He was a guitar player. He was a guitar player. He was a guitar player. He was a guitar player. Yeah, go ahead, Tom. Nineteen seventy-seven-two. We're talking about guitar Frank, and we're going to get to the interesting part now that Lars stepped out. What kind of guitar did he play? Oh, regular guitar. Yeah? Yeah.

How did he tune it? He used to pick the guitar most, you see, but he could play rap, he could play a second, a complement. He didn't use a pick? Yeah, he had to use a pick. Yeah, but could he play with his fingers? Top of it. Yeah, he'd play with his fingers. He could take, he'd play solos, take solos and other things on his guitar. Yeah, he'd do. Well, would he play lead with his fingers? He could play lead with his fingers, way from that neck, from the, from the bridge, clean down to the twelfth. Yeah? Yeah.…
What about on the guitar? Did you take lessons on guitar?
